description: Fetch SEC EDGAR company intelligence, CIK identifier, recent 10-K/10-Q/8-K filings, financials, and news sentiment for any US public company. Pass stock `ticker` or company `query` (e.g. `COIN`, `NVDA`, `AAPL`). Returns `ticker`, `cik`, `company_name`, `recent_filings[]`, `financials`, and `news_sentiment`. Do not use for general web search (use search_web) or crypto-only feeds (use get_crypto_news). 1 free try per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.002 USDC).

fields.description: Return only these result keys, e.g. ["ticker","company_name","recent_filings"]

include_news.description: Include recent news headlines with sentiment for the company

session_token.description: Optional prepaid x402s_... session token from open_agent_session or https://apix402data.com/pay used after the 1 free try rolls over to HTTP 402.

ticker.description: Any SEC-registered stock ticker (e.g., AAPL, COST, WMT, NVDA). Unknown tickers return 404 and are not charged.

tickers.description: Batch: array of up to 5 tickers; priced unit price x count

name: get_sec_company_filings
title: SEC EDGAR company intelligence
